Nature  Trails.
2D. (1) The Director-General may provide
for roads and tracks within a National Reserve
or a Sanctuary on State land to be nature trails
for the use of any person who desires to travel
on foot or otherwise as permitted, to study or
observe the fauna and flora therein :
Provided  that  the  State  shall  not  be  liable
for any injury or damage sustained or incurred
by any person using such trail.
(2) No person shall use any such nature trial
unless he has obtained a permit issued by the
Director-General  upon  the  payment  of  the
prescribed fee.
(3) Regulations may be made specifying the
manner  in  which  any  person  may  use  such
nature trial.
(4)  The  Director-General,  giving  effect  to
the  provisions  of  this  section,  shall  consider
the  advice  and  recommendations  of  the
Advisory  Committee  established  under  this
Ordinance.”.
